UNCERTAINTY: A usable event may exist; bounded metadata search did not qualify it.
WHO_PAYS: Issuer owes contractual principal/accrual; any trading rent would come from secondary-market sellers demanding immediacy, not from the call creating wealth.
WHY_PERSIST: Small $25-note issues, thin liquidity, delisting operations, credit/notice-condition risk and awkward interest accounting reduce institutional scale.
